LightBurn fixtures saved by the user, 2026-11-16 (DXFs: see docs/lightburn-fixtures.md).
- F01 = 40 mm square on layer PEN1. F07 = circles of diameter 2, 10, 50, 200 mm centred at
  (1,100), (17,100), (57,100), (192,100).
- F03 was skipped at first and supplied later (below).
- Job origin was TOP-LEFT (LightBurn's label) for f01, f02, f07 -- not bottom-left as the doc's default says.
- f05 = origin at the CENTRE dot.
- f06-BR = bottom-right origin only.
- f05, f06-BR and f07 were saved with Passes still at 2 (f05/f06-BR are 764 bytes like f02-p2).
- These files use a newer layer layout than the older fixtures (Speed Axis before Layer End,
  Work Mode 6 / Tube Start 3 block). The encoder reproduces all of them (RdLayout::Current).
- F03 = Start From Absolute Coords (Ref Point 2 + Set Absolute), top-right machine, Passes 1; the encoder reproduces it (RdStart::Absolute).
- Added 2026-11-17 (LightBurn 1.4.02; f04-user, f08..f13): F04 = Start From User Origin (Ref Point 1), 80 mm/s, 15/25 %. Layout differs from the 1.4.03 files (RdJob::lead_block).
- F08 spline + arc, F09 segments, F10 nesting, F12 ACI colours imported unchanged (see docs/lightburn-fixtures.md for the colour table).
- F11 does NOT follow the spec: machine layers were used: 1 "Alignment" Scan (fill) 200 mm/s 10.5 %, 2 "Mark" Cut 80 mm/s 15/25 %, 3 "C03" Cut 100 mm/s 15/25 %.
- F13 was first saved unchanged (byte-identical to f04-user) and then redone: min 10 / max 40 %, tube 2 10/20 %, speed 2540 mm/s: the LightBurn station was set to in/s, so 100 was entered as 100 in/s (operator, 2026-11-17). Kept as data; do not run it.
